SCOUT RECOMMENDATION 2026-09-22: Reject - hard gate unsafe_structure_or_heavy_rust.

The model fits the brief (guide s13 names the C30 T5 manual; s2 favors compact hatchbacks) and this
car is a real 6-speed M66, stock, clean title, with a Carfax-documented June 2023 timing belt - the
first item on the guide's C30 checklist. Documentation is unusually good for the money.

It fails on condition. Direct review of mechanical photos 114-116 shows heavy laminating corrosion at
the rocker-to-floor pinch weld with undercoating delaminating in sheets, plus a heavily scaled
subframe. The guide's standard is "No heavy rust; light surface rust can be evaluated." Structural
extent cannot be confirmed without a lift.

Two conditional gates also apply:
- remote_auction_no_ppi: ends 2026-09-23 11:45 AM PDT in Schaumburg IL; no inspection window on the
  one car where inspection is the entire question.
- permanent_warning_lights: TPMS illuminated.

Cost math (app cost state, locality band 2): hammer $4,000 -> $6,370 all-in; $5,000 -> $7,462;
$6,500 -> $9,176. Budget is not the constraint. Add 2022-date-code tires, an undocumented clutch at
122k, and corrosion remediation ranging from a few hundred dollars to subframe replacement.

OPEN / UNVERIFIED: no C30 comps exist in this database, so no defensible market price read. The
auction's own signal - no reserve, 460 watchers, $2,600 at one day out with experienced bidders
talking the rust down - is the best available indication and it points at the underbody.

Kept as the first C30 comp. Re-check after 2026-09-23 11:45 AM PDT to capture the hammer price.

documentation.rationale: VIN-decoded and matched, a genuine Carfax history report with dated service entries (timing belt, coolant, shocks, brakes, turbo control valve), a factory build sheet, and direct photo evidence of the corrosion condition. This is unusually thorough for a $2,600 auction listing; the gap is PCV/oil-trap and clutch-specific documentation.

condition.rationale: Direct photo review confirms severe underbody/rocker/subframe corrosion beyond typical surface rust, with no repair evidence attached; a TPMS fault is also disclosed and unresolved. This is a visible, seller-acknowledged defect with no remediation shown, which caps condition low regardless of the well-documented service history.

price_value.rationale: The $2,600 no-reserve bid is far below what a clean, rust-free manual T5 would command, but the disclosed structural corrosion (described by an experienced bidder as 'near subframe replacement') likely consumes much or all of that discount in remediation cost, and no comps exist yet to anchor fair value.

mission_fit.rationale: Manual transmission and rare trim fit the enthusiast-bridge brief on paper, but a car with confirmed structural corrosion is not a reliable, quickly-resalable bridge vehicle until the extent of the rust is professionally assessed and remediated.

logistics.rationale: Schaumburg, IL is far from Carmel, CA, this is a same-day-closing online auction, and there is no stated pre-purchase inspection access before bidding ends — logistics work against arranging verification before money moves.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: A rare M66 manual T5 C30 with sunroof, wood trim, and an unmodified Maple Red Metallic exterior is a genuinely distinctive, quirky-but-coherent spec per the market notes, satisfying the compact-hatchback preference.

evidence.rationale: The listing and attached Carfax establish a well-documented manual T5 C30 with a completed timing belt/water pump-era service, coolant flush, and routine brake/shock maintenance through 2024, plus a disclosed TPMS fault and 2022-dated tires. Direct review of the seller's own gallery photos (114-116) shows corrosion beyond the seller's 'typical Midwest' framing: delaminating undercoating and scaly laminating rust at the rocker-to-floor pinch weld, and heavy scaling on the subframe, control arms, and exhaust, prompting an experienced bidder to call it 'near subframe replacement.' No PCV/oil-trap service appears anywhere in the visible history despite 122k miles on the B5254T7, a known failure path on this engine. The dealer reports only ~150 miles added since a June 2025 acquisition, meaning the car has been largely static inventory for over a year. The auction is remote (Schaumburg, IL) and closes the same day, with no stated pre-purchase inspection arranged before bidding ends.
evidence.next_action: Request additional close-up underbody photos/video and any repair quote from the dealer, and attempt to arrange a same-day mobile inspection or trusted local eyes-on before the auction closes at 11:45 AM PDT.
